## Summary

**Repair raw Markdown, copy mismatches and exposed endpoint syntax**

Literal ### headings, developer tokens and mismatched latency/circuit-breaker text are visible.

## Priority / wave

- Priority: **P0**
- Wave: **V1**
- Complexity: **S**
- Audit code: `UX-P0-04`
- DUX code: `DUX5-04`

## Scope

Overview, Trust, Provider Health, Run Explorer.

Screenshot groups: SG-04 Provider Health; SG-06 Overview; SG-07 Trust; SG-01 Run Explorer

## Concrete change

Render structured copy correctly; remove raw endpoint/PromQL text from panel bodies; correct metric-specific empty-state copy.

## Expected effect

Panels read as operator UI rather than implementation notes.

## Acceptance criteria

- No literal Markdown markers, Value # headers, raw GET URLs or copy unrelated to the panel metric.
- Aligns with epic acceptance: Status/Reason/Impact/Action visible without internal scroll on first viewport
- No new high-cardinality Prometheus labels
- No hidden verdict logic introduced only in Grafana transforms

## Dependencies

Dashboard JSON and panel descriptions.

## Risk

Low technical risk; copy regression risk.

## Overlap / predecessor notes

New residual: literal Markdown, metric/copy mismatch, exposed endpoints (Provider/Overview/Trust/Run Explorer).

## Constraints

- Surgical dashboard JSON only; preserve panel IDs where possible
- Run Explorer remains forensic owner when moving detail off domain boards
- Prefer description/runbook for caveats; keep first-screen copy to 2-4 lines
- Tech-debt budgets non-increasing

## Verification

- [ ] Before/after screenshots for affected panels (dark theme)
- [ ] Viewports: 1366x768, 1440x900, 1920x1080 at 100% (125% when layout-sensitive)
- [ ] Targeted pytest for navigation/contracts if JSON structure changes
- [ ] Manual operator 5-second comprehension check on first-screen card
